description: Forwards each Claude Code lifecycle event to the hook script the Orca app installs at ~/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh, so Orca can show exact session status. The event list and command mirror the entries Orca writes into ~/.claude/settings.json; Orca does not install them into other config folders (stablyai/orca issue 24873). Outside an Orca pane each entry drains its input and exits.

hooks.command: if [ -n "${ORCA_PANE_KEY-}${ORCA_AGENT_PANE-}" ] && [ -x "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh" ]; then ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID="${PPID:-}"; export ORCA_HOOK_AGENT_PID; /bin/sh "${HOME-}/.orca/agent-hooks/claude-hook.sh"; else cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; printf '{}\n'; fi
